key_points: 8.8% dividend hike to $6.40 annualized signals strong management confidence in cash flow generation and the smoke-free transition
Smoke-free products now ~42% of sales demonstrates meaningful progress in PMI's structural pivot away from combustibles
Sector-wide dip on Sept 21 (sympathy selling on Turning Point Brands news) creates a modest buying opportunity ahead of likely recovery
Consistent dividend growth record reinforces PM's appeal to income-oriented holders, supporting a stable shareholder base
